description_en: Queries the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances that can be imported to a specified cluster. This operation is applicable to ECS clusters
description_zh: 调用ListConvertableEcu接口列出可导入到指定集群的ECS实例列表。本API适用于ECS集群
name: ListConvertableEcu

parameters.description_en: The ID of the cluster. You can call the ListCluster operation to query the cluster ID. For more information, see [ListCluster](~~154995~~).
parameters.help_en: The ID of the cluster. You can call the ListCluster operation to query the cluster ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154995.html
parameters.name: cluster_id
